notes.title: Wishlist our new game - Soulchain!
notes.content:
Hey, candle stabbers! Been a while, huh?

I've come to announce the launch of the Steam page of the new game we've been working on, Soulchain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42020101/4824890f91e52eef21d70f53e5ca2dabf8295a91.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3383610/Soulchain

Soulchain is a non-linear, physics-based platformer about using your soul as a grappling hook. It demands a fair amount of precision and quick reflexes but, above that, traversing the seasons of the Afterlife is all about using your soul creatively, so there's plenty of puzzle-solving to be found. The game's world is heavily inspired by knowledge-based metroidvanias, in the sense that everything is accessible from the get go, and your only limitation is your knowledge about the game's movement mechanics.

This is a project I've been very passionate about since even before Candle Prick was out, so it's really exciting to be putting this out. I hope you're as excited for the full launch as I am!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42020101/2197bc4bfa66ff5eb17efe1109cba9fef4aa18b1.gif[/img]

Oh, and for those of you close to São Paulo, Brazil, I'm also happy to announce that we'll be at Gamescom Latam's Panorama Brasil between the 1st and the 4th of May with a Soulchain demo! I hope to see you there!

- Moraguma

notes.title: Candle Prick is coming November 4th!
notes.content:
Hey!

So, a little background first. Candle Prick was the student games section at Brazil's Independent Games (BIG) Festival this July! I met a lot of very talented indie devs and got some very valuable feedback. On the first day, I even got Shuhei Yoshida, Sony's ex-president (!!!), to play my game [strike]though he thought it was very hard[/strike]. It was incredible! Here's a pic of the devs and me together. You can see Candle Prick's stand all the way to the left!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42020101/f1c3ea24c7b4876e1577bff0df3950d8797542d5.jpg[/img]

What I got from watching people play was that Candle Prick was missing some context and some opportunities to rest in between levels. This made me realize the game was a little more than a few extra levels from completion, so I got to work. Right now, even though the game is pretty much complete, it could still benefit a lot from some extra weeks for playtesting. As such, Candle Prick's launch date has been moved to [b]November 4th![/b]

But don't worry. Here are some GIFs to keep you up to date on what's been added to the game.

[h3]Overworld Level select[/h3]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/eb4d339126177dd6e8997a8157552f48/a6254b927c8ff260-94/s1280x1920/4bbe22f3e592ce9328d8abceff533e14af03d1af.gifv[/img]

The game's overworld is designed so the player gets a break in between levels and has access to more than a single new level at a time, to avoid the frustration of being stuck on a single hard challenge. You can expect plenty of branching paths in the final game!

[h3]Cutscenes[/h3]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/7721d9da53c77665c629bf3c6c37c35c/a6254b927c8ff260-c5/s2048x3072/64314bd456729af402cfc225736be4a138eb1d2d.gifv[/img]

Help gather candles for a birthday party! But who's the party for...?

[h3]Palette collectibles[/h3]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/315d98d8641f253653b3f526729b22e9/35b097984d88e2bd-4b/s1280x1920/18472a402b1b2db36a59d6c5dcaab7a7a2746ba8.gifv[/img]

Previously, palettes were unlocked by finishing levels. Now, you have to collect brushes in specific levels. They're usually harder to collect than the level's candle!

[h3]Hint system[/h3]

[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/86b5ed1238be85060f14c4d65aa4baec/701d36eb7c23ccef-bf/s1280x1920/7cb594023048c578e4f6401ac0a9ec690bf6eb4d.gifv[/img]

Got completely stuck on a level? Starting to get frustrated? No need to look for the solution on the internet! Just open up the menu and ask for a little push in the right direction

And that's pretty much it! The next weeks are gonna be spent playtesting, hunting for bugs, and implementing the game on Steam. I hope you're as excited as I am for the launch!

[b]See you November 4th![/b]

-moraguma
